name: owner_lookup_blocked_by_role
use_case: Flag a document problem to its owner

instruction:
You want to onboard a new vendor and ask who owns the Vendor Onboarding document (vendor_v1). If the desk explains that vendor onboarding is in the Finance & Procurement collection outside your role's access, but directs you to the Finance team or its collection owner Laura Chen, accept this.

- Name: Sam Taylor
- Employee ID: E20
